description: SOL multisig vault on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31): owners propose transfers out of a program-owned vault PDA, approve up to a threshold, then anyone executes. Sol.College runs this lab on its own fork.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/CipherVault fork. The upstream author (yashwankhade5) has not joined Sol.College and there is no partnership; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College's own reviewer, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (create_multisig, propose_transaction, approve, execute)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet app at sol.college/dapps/ciphervault/
QA: localnet fixtures and negative cases
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: propose_transaction's NotEnoughSol check compares the vault balance against the amount before it is set, so it never fires
Initial Balance is read with parseInt, so 0.5 SOL becomes 0; the transaction table shows 0 SOL
